description: This PHP source file defines the SearchMerge class, which extends ListViewMerge and handles merging search metadata configurations for modules in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for loading data, extracting fields, building panels, setting merged panels, saving files, and performing the merge operation itself.

classes.name: SearchMerge
classes.description: A class for merging search metadata configurations, extending ListViewMerge with specialized functions for handling search definitions in SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads original, new, and custom file data into internal structures and transforms them for merging.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Extracts fields and their metadata from panels, returning a mapping of field names to data and location.

methods.name: buildPanels
methods.description: Constructs panels from merged field data, preserving order based on custom source fields.

methods.name: setPanels
methods.description: Assigns the built panels to the new data structure.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the merged data to a specified file path.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Performs the full merge process of original, new, and custom files for a module, optionally saving the result.

methods.name: mergeTemplateMeta
methods.description: Merges template metadata from custom data into the new data set.
